author: JakobNorway
body:
Age:12
Timezone:CET (dvs. GMT +1)
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No:Yes
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No:Yes
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No:i can get
 
CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION
 
Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? No
 
What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? my biggest weakness, i dont really have some.My biggest strenght i dont really have some there either.
 
 
How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?i am in a Timezone there all the other staff's is sleeping or doing something else.
 
What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? a leader needs to be online alot and be nice to other people and help. I can  consider my self as a leader.
 
What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? I am 12 years old and going to apply for mod, have played for over 3 years on avicus and have a team and know how Ts works
 
What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?i can be online much and i know most of the moderators. Yes i think i have those skills
 
 
How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 1 year 1/5 or more
 
 
CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS
 
You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? Send reports to mojang and gonna try to ban him wneh hes hacking or gets on again
 
 
Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? Talk to him and try to get him out or send a mail to the Admins
 
 
A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? talked to the mods and admins to look at him
 
You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? i would talk to the mod and say dont do it again i know it not importan but next time maybe it can 
 
One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? If all the other staffs like it i would think on it, if i dont like it i would talked about it
 
 
CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.
 
 
What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? I would love it to help other player and the community
 
 
How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? Alot i have been playing it almost everyday in 1/5 year
 
 
Do you speak any other languages than English? Norwegian
 
 
    Do you have anything else to add to your application?
